title: Manifest-driven deploy with dry-run, backup-on-conflict and audit
Secrets hygiene: plaintext/permissions audit and systematic op run wrapping
rationale: 1Password op:// references + op run already cover it; the audit/wrapper remainder is speculative hygiene with no signal of an actual problem.

title: Real dotfiles test suite (per-file test_*.sh)
Declarative macOS defaults (desired-state + drift) replacing imperative .macos
mise instead of asdf
rationale: asdf works and runtimes are pinned; ergonomics-only benefit doesn't clear the replace-a-working-tool bar.

title: zsh migration (or ble.sh in-place) for interactive ergonomics
SessionStart hook injecting version-manager env into agent sessions
Local desktop notification on agent Stop/Notification
Custom Claude Code statusline (context %, cache hit rate, cost, branch)
Curl-able bootstrap script for a bare machine
Merge tracked settings onto a live file instead of skip-worktree
Single namespaced CLI over the flat bin/ and make targets
rationale: make targets plus a flat bin/ already work; a dispatcher adds a layer of indirection without adding a capability.

title: Codebase-audit git aliases (churn, bus-factor, hotspots, velocity)
rationale: ~60 aliases and .githelpers already cover the daily workflow; repo forensics is rare enough to write ad hoc when it comes up.

title: ERR trap reporting failing command and source:line in repo scripts
Cross-app theme switching via a current/ symlink indirection
rationale: built for a tiling-WM stack this machine does not have; iTerm profiles resist file-level theming, so the payoff is tmux and vim colors only.

title: One idempotent converge command replacing the README's manual sequence
Replace bespoke manifest+deploy.sh with rcm (rcup/lsrc, tags)
rationale: rcm's tag model is strictly weaker than the manifest's condition column (cannot express tool=, host=, or the bin.Darwin -> ~/bin rename), and manifest-deploy already shipped.

title: fish as the interactive shell (sibling to the zsh-migration spike)
Per-ecosystem install manifests beyond Brewfile (VS Code extensions, npm globals)
Shared OS/host predicate helpers instead of re-derived uname expressions
Assert shell helpers behave, not just that they are defined
bats-core instead of the bespoke pass/fail test harness
rationale: The bespoke harness already works and is ~80 lines; sandboxing and assertions stay ours either way, so the only gain is less scaffolding, paid for with a bats-core install on both CI runners.

title: CI that installs onto a bare machine instead of smoke-testing symlinks
File associations as a data file instead of an imperative script
Root .editorconfig so whitespace conventions are declared, not inferred
One command to update every package manager on the machine
rationale: Subsumed by the open converge-setup spike (#28), which asks a strictly larger version of the same question; adopting topgrade now would pre-commit that spike's answer.

title: Move deployed config under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME
rationale: Benefit is home-directory tidiness only, which does not clear the foundation bar. The repo already runs a mixed layout (kitty and opencode under ~/.config, everything else at home root) and it works; ~/.claude, ~/.agents and ~/.copilot do not honor XDG and would stay at home root regardless, so a migration converts one mixed layout into another at the cost of auditing every ~/.x literal.

title: GNU stow instead of manifest + deploy.sh
rationale: Same defect as the already-rejected rcm-deploy: stow has no condition model, so os=, host=, tool= and the bin.Darwin -> ~/bin rename are inexpressible. Strictly less expressive than the manifest that already shipped with tests.

title: Test the executable code that lives inside skills
One preflight command, so CI and the developer share a definition of "checked"
Generated index of available skills
Validate frontmatter content, not just that it parses
Checked-in cron for recurring local automation
rationale: No demonstrated need for scheduled local automation here, and their implementation concedes in-comment that the tracked crontab drifts from the real one by hand -- adopting it would import the drift and then require building the audit to fix it.

title: Publish skills as an installable package, not just a symlink source
Shellcheck every shell file, discovered by file(1) rather than by extension
Self-documenting Makefile with a help target
Dependabot on GitHub Actions versions
Codex CLI as an additional agent harness fed from home/.agents/rules
rationale: No demonstrated Codex use here, and the concatenation machinery it depends on is unlanded (PR #32 builds it for Pi); adding a fifth harness shim before the fourth has merged compounds unproven work. Reconsider if Codex enters the toolchain.
